scenes.name: dungeon
scenes.note: A dungeon level, fully revealed.

scenes.name: town
scenes.note: The town from the start in the pub, zoomed out.

scenes.name: fog
scenes.note: Walk five tiles east so explored-but-unseen tiles show.

scenes.name: tab
scenes.note: Tab twice selects the third hero, who walks; the party stands on (40,21) (41,21) (39,21) (40,22).

scenes.name: targeting
scenes.note: A fake cursor and the targeting overlay for a scroll.

scenes.name: fx
scenes.note: The missile effect about 0.15 s in.

scenes.name: combat
scenes.note: Walk into two goblins: a move, a dash, End Turn, the enemy phase (the goblin waits on overwatch), a step that draws its reaction, an attack on the hobgoblin beside Aldric.

scenes.name: hud
scenes.note: HUD buttons by --press: Wait starts combat, End Turn, the second card selects Brenna, Attack.

scenes.name: cleave
scenes.note: Aldric's Cleave on two adjacent goblins, then its cooldown in round 2.

scenes.name: aimed
scenes.note: Brenna's Aimed Shot at seven tiles through the targeting screen.

scenes.name: fireball
scenes.note: Corin's Fireball between two goblins.

scenes.name: heal
scenes.note: Dagny heals a wounded Aldric in combat (20/34 to 30/34).
expect: Dagny uses Heal on Aldric, healing 10 hp.

scenes.name: bow
scenes.note: Aldric picks up and equips a bow, then shoots.

scenes.name: cover
scenes.note: Tables give half cover; Brenna flanks. The orc is a brute, so it closes in.
scenes.args: --seed 42 --depth 2 --reveal-map --console godmode --console "place 5 0 Orc" --console "place 1 0 Table" --console "place 1 -1 Table" --console "place 1 1 Table" --click 40,20 --keys e --click 41,21 --keys n --click 40,21 --click 41,21 --frames 120

scenes.name: overwatch
scenes.note: Aldric on overwatch with a bow reacts to a goblin walking in.

scenes.name: ow_monster
scenes.note: A goblin in full cover at 43,26 (pillar west of it) faces Brenna on overwatch: moving draws a shot and gains nothing, so it goes on overwatch, and reacts when the next hero (Corin) walks up beside it.

scenes.name: hunker
scenes.note: Aldric hunkers behind a table; the orc picks the easier target, Dagny (its best hit chance).
scenes.args: --seed 42 --depth 2 --reveal-map --console godmode --console "place 5 0 Orc" --console "place 1 0 Table" --console "place 1 -1 Table" --console "place 1 1 Table" --click 40,20 --keys he --frames 90

scenes.name: buy
scenes.note: Walk to the blacksmith, buy the first item, show the inventory.

scenes.name: sell
scenes.note: Sell a picked-up dagger to the blacksmith.

scenes.name: loop
scenes.note: Sell, take the dungeon entrance (12,28 in the scenes town), read a Town Portal, open the ledger.
expect: You return to town after 1 day away

scenes.name: chars_party
scenes.note: The party in hero models at the start of a dungeon level, torchlit, gameplay zoom.

scenes.name: chars_party_zoom
scenes.note: The same, zoomed in.

scenes.name: chars_town
scenes.note: Every town character in a row two tiles south of the active hero, gameplay zoom.
scenes.args: --seed 42 --depth 0 --reveal-map --console "teleport 12 23" --console "place -5 2 Barkeep" --console "place -4 2 Patron" --console "place -3 2 Priest" --console "place -2 2 Blacksmith" --console "place -1 2 Clothier" --console "place 0 2 Alchemist" --console "place 1 2 Mom" --console "place 2 2 Peasant" --console "place 3 2 Enchanter" --frames 120

scenes.name: chars_town_zoom
scenes.note: The town line-up zoomed in.
scenes.args: --seed 42 --depth 0 --reveal-map --console "teleport 12 23" --console "place -5 2 Barkeep" --console "place -4 2 Patron" --console "place -3 2 Priest" --console "place -2 2 Blacksmith" --console "place -1 2 Clothier" --console "place 0 2 Alchemist" --console "place 1 2 Mom" --console "place 2 2 Peasant" --console "place 3 2 Enchanter" --keys "..++++++" --frames 200

scenes.name: chars_walk
scenes.note: Walk five tiles east: the heroes turn to face the way they glide.

scenes.name: kill_all
scenes.note: kill_all fells every monster (a placed goblin beside the party too), then the party walks to where the combat scene meets goblins.

scenes.name: ai_ranged
scenes.note: A Goblin Archer (ranged) spots the party and moves north to 47,18, where the pillar at 46,18 gives it full cover from all four heroes and only Dagny has a line of sight; it shoots Dagny.

scenes.name: ai_brute
scenes.note: An Orc (brute) dashes in from seven tiles beside Aldric, then attacks in the next enemy phase.

scenes.name: ai_group
scenes.note: Kobolds (vision 4) four tiles apart in a line east: the nearest spots the party and wakes the next two in a chain; the fourth, seven tiles on, sleeps.
scenes.args: --seed 42 --depth 2 --reveal-map --console godmode --console "place 4 0 Kobold" --console "place 8 0 Kobold" --console "place 12 0 Kobold" --console "place 19 0 Kobold" --keys ' e' --frames 200

scenes.name: ai_hunt
scenes.note: A rat (vision 4) sees only Corin and starts a fight; Corin steps out of its sight, yet combat goes on (his overwatch works) until it gives up four enemy phases later.
